messages:
alex: Kicking off a region-by-region rollout for v2.3.1-rc2. Change window 02:00-05:00 UTC. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Canary slices only, initial traffic 2% for each region. Rollback triggers: >=3% error rate OR p95 latency > 450ms sustained for 3m. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.1-rc2

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary us-east (slice us-1) -> v2.3.1-rc2 at 02:05 UTC, target 2% traffic. Logs: /deploys/3329501234/us-1

maria: quick capacity check before we ramp: US serving pool free_gpus=120, warm_pool=12, queued_warmups=2. Dashboard: https://observability/ui/regions/us

jamal: smoke test ready. running the curl check now:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"health check"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

deploy-bot: smoke OK for us-1: p50=78ms p95=210ms errors=0.02% throughput=420rps

alex: Hold 15m for stability. If p95 stays <300ms and errors <0.5% we ramp to 20% and then to 100% for region. Also pin region mapping when US hits steady state: `region_pin.us = v2.3.1-rc2`

frankie: FYI I updated the release notes with the quantization nuance and cache invalidation note (see section "breaking-behavior"). Link: https://docs.internal/release/v2.3.1

maria: US canary steady at 2% for 15m. Metrics look good. ready to ramp to 20% at 02:25 UTC.

deploy-bot: ramping us-1 -> 20% at 02:25 UTC

deploy-bot: us-1 ramp complete -> 100% traffic for region at 02:40 UTC (pin applied: region_pin.us=v2.3.1-rc2)

jamal: EU start blocked by a scheduled infra maintenance in eu-west-2 at 03:10 UTC. Suggest delaying EU canary by +30m. APAC also has a batch job at 04:00 UTC that will conflict with warm pools.

alex: OK shift EU start to 03:40 UTC, APAC start to 05:00 UTC. Keep EU canary traffic tight (3%) initially. Update change window in the release notes.

frankie: added note to release doc: "EU delayed due to infra maintenance; APAC delayed due to batch windows. See timeline table."

maria: running EU capacity pre-check: eu_pool.free_gpus=82, eu_warm=6, recent_evictions=1 (last 24h). Concerns: background maintenance could cause transient eviction spikes.

jamal: sounds risky. If we see eviction-driven errors, auto-rollback should kick and pin back to v2.2.9. Rollback command is:
```
rdctl region rollback --region eu --to-version v2.2.9 --force --follow
```

deploy-bot: starting eu-west-1 canary at 03:40 UTC -> target 3%

deploy-bot: eu-west-1 telemetry (first 3m): p50=95ms p95=420ms errors=3.5% -> threshold exceeded. Initiating rollback per policy.

alex: Confirming. Jamal, execute rollback now and notify customers affected in EU. Tag release notes with incident stub.

jamal: running rollback command now.

deploy-bot: rollback completed for eu-west-1: pinned to v2.2.9, traffic routed back to fallback cluster. Command output: "pin succeeded, traffic rebalanced"

maria: EU rollback observed. After rollback p95 back to 230ms and errors <0.2%. We backfilled EU traffic to US capacity for transient load.

alex: Good. Immediate action items: 1) Mark APAC start as delayed until we re-evaluate capacity and warm pool warming strategy. 2) Create a short incident note in the release doc about the EU rollback cause (evictions + p95 near threshold). 3) Schedule a post-rollout follow-up to test different warm pool sizes and eviction-resistant config.

frankie: I've appended an incident note in the release doc and flagged the quantization change for targeted regression tests. Also added a follow-up item: "increase warm_pool for eu by +4 and re-run canary during a low-ops window."

jamal: APAC will be held. We should not start until warmers complete and billing jobs finish. Suggest next attempt at 07:30 UTC local.

alex: Agreed. We'll call this a partial rollout: US succeeded, EU rolled back, APAC postponed. I'll send a short summary to engineering and customers: include known cause and mitigation plan.

frankie: summary ready, posting to #announcements and will attach the release notes + quick rollback timeline.

alex: Thanks everyone. Postmortem + follow-ups in the release issue tracker: https://triage/internal/issues/RELEASE-3329501234

maria: thumbs up :thumbsup:

jamal: copying ops on the rollback timeline and commands.

deploy-bot: closing thread for deploy 3329501234. If further manual intervention required, reopen with `/deploy reopen 3329501234`.
